name: Your Ghost in the Machine
source:
You are Karel, a researcher. Your colleague Josef is working on an algorithm to transfer a human brain into a machine, but he is suffering from a terminal illness. If he completes his research will he be able to cheat death?

[From [url=https://supercircuit.itch.io/your-ghost-in-the-machine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是卡雷尔，一名研究员。你的同事约瑟夫正在研究一种将人脑转移到机器中的算法，但他患有绝症。如果他完成了研究，他就能逃脱死亡吗？

[来自[url=https://supercircuit.itch.io/your-ghost-in-the-machine]Itch.io[/url]]
